title: bn254-gt-dlp: STNFS with conditional PGF descent, expected work2^93.769200172

claims.statement: For the full-production bn254-gt-dlp target, the precise algorithm of proof.md, field-map.md, DESCENT.md, KERNELS.md and STORAGE.md returns x with g^x=z with success at least0.39 over uniform challenges and fresh coins under H1-H4, H-EA, H-X, H-FFT, the conditional node PGF envelope H5(alpha=1/2), boot single-trial smoothness, and H-SEP(the per-curve ECM factor-extraction probability is at least one half the modeled order-hit probability), with their support and extrapolation limits disclosed. Expected total classical work is at most1+(K/2^64)2^95.121135770<2^93.769200172 units, C=20,000 scalar AArch64 instruction equivalents. All preprocessing, advice construction, failed trials, aborts, arithmetic, transfers, verification and output are charged once for this target. The independent64-bit run gate fails unless v<K=7226808642105335985, the least K with (K/2^64)x0.995492>=0.39. Opened-run success is at least0.995492; expected two-log work is at most2^94.858852 units. Non-log work is metered at2^112 units and both logarithms together at2^115, so every run costs less than2^115.169925002 units. The calculation charges both meter losses plus recursive, node-counter and repeat losses. This is an expected-work claim; there is no negative-binomial lazy-cofactor discount, DISC confidence allowance, whole-ball boot waiting-time assertion or fixed-family universal positivity premise. Nothing is amortized over other targets. Analytic exploratory claim; small experiments do not prove production success or price bounds.

experiments.purpose: Recompute the field, collection, filtering and cost-ledger arithmetic, including revised PGF-envelope descent and finite ECM-separation assumptions; rebuild returns rounded draft declarations. Arithmetic passes do not establish production hypotheses. part=pgf recomputes alpha=.5 PGF envelopes at psi=0..0.8 step .01 on all862 downward-rounded raw-mu toy observations; part=porttoy redoes an exact whole ball or parent/child/control from fixed seeds. These are scoped toy checks, not production proofs. Default{} also replays all862 PGF observations.
